name: Centera Photonics Inc.
summary: Centera Photonics Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of optoelectronic system on chips (SoC) and silicon photonic devices. It offers optical interconnect modules and OE-ICs for optical communications. The company was formerly known as CENTERA and changed its name to Centera Photonics Inc. in June 2011. Centera Photonics Inc. was founded in 2010 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
